claim_verdicts.evidence: Scoped: "Register scoped services by calling AddScoped." Registration table: `Add{LIFETIME}<{SERVICE}, {IMPLEMENTATION}>()` and `Add{LIFETIME}<{IMPLEMENTATION}>()`. "Registering a service with only an implementation type is equivalent to registering that service with the same implementation and service type."

"Before C# 14, you add the this modifier to the first parameter of a static method to indicate that the method appears as a member of an instance of the parameter type." "Both forms of extensions must be defined inside a non-nested, nongeneric static class." Reworded claim and §3 now say "in the form Đơn Hàng uses" and "in a static class"; matches ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:10-12.

EF Core provider table: "PostgreSQL* | `.UseNpgsql(connectionString)` | Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL". DonHang.Infrastructure.csproj references Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL (10.0.3 per versions.yaml).

Narrowed to constructor parameters as asked in r1; the throw half holds (r1 scratch app: `Unable to resolve service for type 'Svc' while attempting to activate 'TController'.`). Residual edge: "Constructors can accept arguments that aren't provided by dependency injection, but the arguments must assign default values." A parameter declared `= null` with no registration receives its default, i.e. null. No Đơn Hàng constructor declares a default, so the lesson's examples are unaffected.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: When a constructor asks for a type that has no registration, and the parameter has no default value (none of Đơn Hàng's do), the container throws InvalidOperationException naming that type instead of passing null.

claim_verdicts.evidence: "Now, in the development environment, ValidateOnBuild and ValidateScopes are enabled." "Apps usually run in the Development environment during local development and testing on a developer's machine" (supports "a mode meant for local work"). docker-compose.yml:93 `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: "Development"`. r1 scratch app, Development, INotifier removed: `AggregateException: Some services are not able to be constructed (... Unable to resolve service for type 'INotifier' while attempting to activate 'Svc'.)`.

"By default, ASP.NET Core doesn't register controllers as services in the DI container. The runtime uses the DefaultControllerActivator to create controller instances and resolves services from the DI container for constructor parameters". Scratch app, Development, Svc unregistered: `BUILD OK`, then GET → `InvalidOperationException ... activate 'TController'` → 500. ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.cs catch (Exception) writes 500 (InvalidOperationException is not KeyNotFound/Argument).

OrdersController.cs:12 `OrdersController(OrderService orderService, IOrderRepository repository)`; OrderService.cs `OrderService(IOrderRepository repository, INotifier notifier)`; ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:15 is the only IOrderRepository registration (git grep at stage-1). Scratch app: controller and Svc both resolved IRepo from one AddScoped line (GET → 200).

Follows from the code: the only INotifier registration is ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:16 and Program.cs names no notifier. Holds on the condition that the new class's constructor needs only types already registered (see minor issue on §7).

"The AddDbContext extension method registers DbContext types with a scoped lifetime by default." This is how context configuration from AddDbContext is passed to the DbContext."
